hero.title: The New Synagogue — a home for the community
hero.lead: On the historic site of the 1896 synagogue: prayers and Shabbat, holidays, classes, help, and tours for visitors to the city.

scene.aria: History of the synagogue: from Königsberg to our days

threshold.title: Welcome home
threshold.note: The synagogue is open to the community and guests: come to pray, to celebrate a holiday, to study, or for a tour.

prayer.text: Morning, afternoon and evening prayers, welcoming Shabbat on Friday evening and seeing it off — times for every day are in the schedule.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.text: Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur, Sukkot, Hanukkah, Purim, Passover and Shavuot — the year the community lives by.

programs.text: Torah study, activities for children and youth, meetings for everyone who wants to learn more about the tradition.

help.text: Tzedakah is one of the foundations of Jewish life: the community supports those in need and welcomes volunteers.
